confidence_notes: Food anchors use Ubud city price-index averages updated 2 October 2026; its sample is limited. Accommodation prices are holistic estimates without live listing checks. Cocktail and wine anchors use a beer-price relationship because comparable direct data is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used; food anchors use Ubud's own reported averages, while accommodation estimates reflect its established visitor destination and guesthouse mix.
